supersedes.note: v2 was a single verified page. v3 keeps that page's nine chapters verbatim in structure and rebuilds it from a shared shell, then adds ten interior pages.

shell.navigation: Logo, five primary links, Book a Consult, menu button at every breakpoint. Drawer is the full site index. On the home page only, the links cross-fade out and the chapter readout fades in once the nav goes solid — pure CSS via .nav[data-journey='1'].solid.

pagekitAttributes.data-count: counter; prints final value under reduced motion

verification.screenshots: capture-slices.mjs — scroll-slice driver; captureBeyondViewport is invalid under ScrollSmoother
verification.contrastAudit: site-test.mjs scores every text node whose background resolves to an opaque colour; nodes over imagery are counted and reported as unscorable rather than guessed at
verification.mobileReview: All eleven pages captured at 390x844 and reviewed; review/m-*/ and review/m2-*, m3-* for re-checks
